about: The nesting-depth counting rule of design section 8.1 with its examples, plus the extra cases CORE-F tests. Owner: CORE-F. Other modules (build, audit, split) may read this file to test that they use lib.formula. depth = largest number of function calls open at the same time; limit 2.

brackets inside text do not count
unary minus and grouping parentheses do not count
